prompt:
Make one image now, without questions and without describing it. A vertical portrait picture; keep everything important away from the very top and bottom edges, because the picture is cropped to 4:5.

The reference image is the picture attached at the start of this chat (the cover of this carousel): keep its characters, faces, clothes, home and 3D animated style exactly.

Use the reference image as the exact character and style reference. Keep the same child and parent: same faces, ages, hair, skin tone, body proportions, clothing and the same feature-film 3D animated style, lighting and textures. Create a new scene and camera angle; do not copy the reference layout.

Characters, identical on every slide: A 3-year-old Israeli girl with short dark curly hair, olive skin, big brown eyes and a small gap-toothed smile; about 95 cm tall. Her mother and her father, both early thirties, kind brown eyes: the mother with dark wavy hair in a loose bun, the father with short dark hair and a trimmed beard; warm and a little tired in a real way. Wardrobe: Girl: a mustard-yellow t-shirt with a small white star and soft grey leggings. Mother: oatmeal knit cardigan over a white tee. Father: a navy t-shirt.

Scene: The girl runs and climbs on the sofa cushions, laughing, a diaper peeking out above her leggings, her parents watching with a smile. Setting: The family's cosy Israeli living room: a beige sofa, a soft rug, a toy basket, a plain pale wall. The upper third of the frame stays calm: a plain soft background, no faces or hands there.

Feature-film 3D animated style: smooth soft-shaded stylised characters with large expressive eyes, rounded features, gentle subsurface skin glow, detailed knit and linen fabric textures, warm cinematic lighting, soft depth of field, rich but tender colour. Cute faces: large round eyes with soft sparkly catch-lights, chubby rosy cheeks, small soft noses and chins; the child has a slightly bigger head relative to the body. Clearly an animated film still, never a photograph. Lived-in Israeli apartment details.

Palette: warm cream (#F8F0E1) walls and textiles, plum and violet accents (#5B2BD6, #291852), muted gold highlights (#C9954A). Low saturation, warm white balance.

Avoid photorealism, glossy advertising smiles, exaggerated sadness or tears, staged stock-photo poses and any uncanny or distorted hands or faces.

Composition: vertical 4:5. Keep the upper third of the frame calm: a plain wall or soft background with no faces, hands or important objects in it, because words are set over it later. No words, letters or numbers anywhere in the image.

No generated words, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, signatures, frames, borders or user interface anywhere in the image, including on books, screens, clothing, toys and signs.

After this picture I will send more pictures for the same series, one per message, with only a new Scene. Keep every rule above for all of them: same characters, same style, vertical, calm upper third, no words, letters or numbers.
